text.tspan: Seq2seq dot attention / context fusion | Module decomposition
IBM Attention / D16,query3,context8 / masked unscaled dot / returns weights / read bottom to top
B=batch; query3 positions attend over8 encoder positions; D16.
Gray mask is optional source state, selected here; True blocks a score.
One learned linear_out follows [mix, original output]; no score projections.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
